item.title: Two Weeks on a Bicycle Around Taiwan
item.description: After two years of Peace Corps service in Timor-Leste, I traveled Southeast Asia for almost six months. The last thing I did in Asia was do a cycle tour around Taiwan.

item.title: A Week in Jogja
item.description: A story from my first time travelling abroad solo. This was a time of a lot of firsts. Yogyakarta is an amazing city and I hope I could capture some of it's allure in this brief story.

item.title: Running, Possibilities, a Birthday, and a Beach
item.description: A long-winded story about running and friends. It reflects well the era when I wrote it. The first half is much more worth reading than the second, though I often think about Jacinto.
